name: hapifhir/hapi-fhir
what_it_is: HAPI FHIR is a Java library and server framework for building HL7 FHIR clients and servers, providing both a plain/facade server mode and a full JPA server with its own relational-database schema covering FHIR DSTU2 through R5.
measurement: Search result caching with configurable TTL
constraints: Requires relational database; Elasticsearch is supplementary only
MySQL/MariaDB deprecated due to poor performance
Partitioned server uses single shared ID pool
Referential integrity enforced at application layer only
notable_absences: No Kafka subscription transport in core
